column3: web/src/views/storefront.ts renders a chip per category from GET /api/v1/catalog, where handlePublicCatalog returns every visible category (children and empty ones included) with product_count of its own products, so Paymenter's top-level-only, has-children-or-visible-products rule is not applied.

categories.parent_id with the categories_guard_tree trigger (cycle refusal plus a four-level bound) and the public GET /api/v1/catalog/categories and /api/v1/catalog/category/{slug} routes exist, but storefront.ts still reads the flat /api/v1/catalog and filters client-side and web/src/routes.ts declares no /products/:category page.

storefront-product.ts shows the logo, the sanitised description, plans in price_versions.sort_order with interval labels and setup fees, but publicProductJSON sends no stock and no config options and the page has no option picker, so a plan with required options cannot be bought from the storefront.

products.hidden is filtered in SQL by catalog.Public and catalog.PublicProduct through the hidden_branches CTE, so a hidden product or anything under a hidden category is absent from the storefront and still bills.

product_images (0018_catalog.sql) stores the bytes, POST /api/v1/staff/catalog/images uploads them and handleMedia serves /api/v1/media/{id} with nosniff, an immutable cache and an SVG sandbox, which is what the CSP img-src 'self' data: allows.
categories has description, sort_order, hidden and parent_id but no image column, and storefront.ts renders a text chip per category, so category imagery is still missing while product images exist.

products.stock (NULL = unlimited) is locked FOR UPDATE in sorted order and decremented by register.checkoutTx and returned by lifecycle.CancelUnpaidOrders, but no service termination or cancellation path calls service.RestoreStock, so a terminated service never puts its unit back.

products.per_user_limit is enforced in register.checkoutTx under the product lock and again by service.CheckPerUserLimit, and both count pending subscriptions as held units, so ten unpaid orders cannot become ten servers.

products.allow_quantity exists with disabled, separated and combined and disabled is honoured in commerce.AddItemTx and register (quantity_not_allowed), but separated and combined behave identically: quantity N yields one order item and one subscription rather than N independent services.
products.sort_order (0018_catalog.sql) orders catalog.Public by category then product and is editable per product in web/src/views/catalog-admin-product.ts.

products.email_template (bounded by 0031_product_email_template.sql) is read by internal/notify/activation.go and rendered as {{product_instructions}} in the activation mail, with an empty value falling back to the shipped sentence.

products.server_id, the servers table and PUT /api/v1/staff/catalog/products/{id}/server let an operator assign a node, but nothing reads products.server_id: register.provisionTarget and internal/orders both take only price_versions.provision_region, so the assignment never reaches CreateRequest.Region.

0028_plan_types.sql widens price_versions.interval to monthly, quarterly, semiannual, annual, one_time and free with a CHECK that a free price is zero, and storefront-product.ts reads the server's recurring flag so a one-time plan is not described as a subscription.

0059_n_day_periods.sql and internal/calendar implement every_<N>_days for N in 1..366 as a civil-day period model, but N-week and N-month units are still not expressible: a week is 7 days and months remain the four fixed calendar intervals.

price_versions.name (0018_catalog.sql) and price_versions.sort_order (0028_plan_types.sql) are real columns, with the plan-order write in internal/httpapi/catalog_polish.go and the sort field in catalog-admin-product.ts, and storefront-product.ts renders plans in that order.

price_versions carries amount_minor, setup_minor, currency and interval per version, prices are append-only through POST /api/v1/staff/catalog/products/{id}/prices, and an issued invoice snapshots the version it priced from.

catalog.Public filters with EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM price_versions ...) and publicProductJSON emits each price with its own currency and amount, so a currency with no price row is simply not listed rather than rendered as zero.

GET /api/v1/currencies, the selector in cart.ts and the fixed-once-non-empty rule in commerce.CartTx exist, but the storefront never reads the ?currency= parameter cart.ts sets and /api/v1/catalog has no currency filter, so the switcher does not change what the storefront offers.

internal/i18n resolves from the locales table (enabled flag), GET /api/v1/i18n/locales and /api/v1/i18n/messages feed lib/i18n.ts, and storefront.ts and storefront-product.ts render languageSwitcher plus tx() at build time.

web/src/routes.ts puts /, /products and /products/:slug in PUBLIC_PATHS and isStorefrontPath, while /cart and /checkout are customer prefixes and every /api/v1/portal/cart route requires a session, so browsing is anonymous and buying is not.

general.tos and checkout.tos_required in internal/settings/settings.go drive register.ReadPolicy (ErrTOSRequired to tos_required), carts.tos_accepted_at records the acceptance, and checkout.ts posts the real tos_accepted checkbox.

the public API has GET /api/v1/catalog/categories and /api/v1/catalog/category/{slug} with a slug path, but web/src/routes.ts has no category route and storefront.ts keeps one index page filtered by ?category=, so a category has no shareable or crawlable URL.

carts and cart_items (0020_commerce.sql) hold customer_id UNIQUE, currency, coupon_id and tos_accepted_at, and commerce.CartTx get-or-creates one cart per customer with cart_items_unique merging an identical line.

storefront-product.ts posts /api/v1/portal/cart/items and commerce.AddItemTx applies allow_quantity plus the merge ceiling, reporting already_in_cart, not_applicable and not_found as distinct messages on the product page.

commerce.Store.totalsFor prices amount, setup and coupon per line and cartTotals applies the tax pricer, but loadPrice never reads config_option_prices, so an option's price is added only at checkout in register.loadConfig and the cart total can be lower than the invoice.
cart.ts renders quantity steppers, a per-line remove and an Empty cart action backed by PUT and DELETE /api/v1/portal/cart/items/{id} and DELETE /api/v1/portal/cart in commerce_cart.go.

cart.ts couponCard applies and removes a code through POST and DELETE /api/v1/portal/cart/coupon, commerce.ApplyCouponTx validates window, scope, uses and currency, and Totals re-validates on every read with coupon_problem shown in the UI.

POST /api/v1/portal/orders needs a session and PermInvoicePaySelf, register.ReadPolicy refuses without terms acceptance (tos_required) or a verified address when the installation requires it, and checkout.ts submits the real checkbox state.

register.CheckoutService.checkoutTx writes orders, order_items, subscriptions and the invoice in one transaction and locks products.stock in sorted order before the limit check, with customer_id derived from the session in checkout_customer.go.

register.checkout.go treats payable == 0 by skipping the invoice, activating the subscriptions through activateZeroTotal, creating the service and marking the order paid, and checkout.ts reports activated with an empty invoice_id.

orders and order_items (0001_core.sql) hold customer, currency and total, invoices.order_id and services.order_id (0029_service_metadata.sql) link both sides, and staff_read.go handleStaffOrder returns the order with items, invoices and payment attempts.

staff_read.go handleStaffOrders and handleStaffOrder plus orders.go POST /api/v1/staff/orders and the /orders/new screen give create, list and detail only, with no edit, delete or cancel endpoint, and docs/parity-status.md records order editing as a deliberate divergence.

lifecycle.CancelUnpaidOrders reads cronjob.order_cancel_days, flips pending_payment under FOR UPDATE, voids open invoices through the void path, reverses the receivable, calls service.RestoreStock and cancels pending subscriptions, wired as a kill-switchable cron job.

no cancel-subscription-id action exists: nothing in internal/httpapi or web/src matches cancel_subscription or cancelSubscription, web/src/views/service.ts only prints the internal subscription id with a copy button, and the only cancellation paths are the service-cancellation queue and POST /api/v1/portal/services/{id}/cancel, neither of which calls a gateway.

extproto/events.go declares v2 events.subscribe and events.deliver and httpapi/extension_hooks.go forwards the in-process broker to extensions, but only order.created and the ticket kinds are ever published, so cart.created, cart.updated, cart.abandoned, cart.checked_out, order.paid and order.cancelled are declared and never emitted.
